name: OUR LAST HOPE; sex with robots!
source:
You travel alone in your shuttle to a suspicious space station that drifted from it's usual orbit. As you are trying to uncover the mystery of this peculiar place ran by robots you find yourself in a situation where it seems the robots are in dire need of a human's "touch".

In this visual novel you can explore a seemingly abandoned space station. With branching story lines where you choices matter and you can freely choose your path to discover this futuristic environment.

[From [url=https://wikkedsick.itch.io/our-last-hope-sex-with-robots]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你独自乘坐航天飞机前往一个偏离正常轨道的可疑空间站。当你试图揭开这个由机器人经营的奇特地方的秘密时，你发现自己处于一种情况，机器人似乎迫切需要人类的“触摸”。

在这部视觉小说中，你可以探索一个看似废弃的空间站。通过分支故事情节，你的选择很重要，你可以自由选择探索这个未来环境的路径。

[来自[url=https://wikkedsick.itch.io/our-last-hope-sex-with-robots]Itch.io[/url]]
